question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**that**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, we need to use a **relative clause **to connect two sentences.
 
• We use relative clauses to give particular information about **things** and **people**.
 
• In the given sentence, we will use **that **since we are talking about amino acid
